import os,json,urllib.request,urllib.error,concurrent.futures,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/mcpjam-eval')
def get(p):
 req=urllib.request.Request(os.environ['MCPJAM_API_URL']+p,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['MCPJAM_API_KEY']})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15) as r: data=r.read().decode()
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:data=e.read().decode()
 (root/(p.strip('/').replace('/','_')+'.json')).write_text(data)
 print(p,data)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as ex:list(ex.map(get,['/me','/projects/project_fixture/servers','/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites','/models','/organizations']))
